topic: 皮层神经发生 / Inside-Out 规则 / 外放射状胶质细胞 / NOTCH2NL

sources.citation: Angevine JB & Sidman RL (1961). Autoradiographic study of cell migration during histogenesis of cerebral cortex in the mouse. Science 133:1927–1928.
sources.relevance: 首次确立皮层 Inside-Out 出生规律（³H-thymidine 脉冲标记）；奠基性文献

sources.citation: Englund C, Fink A, Lau C, et al. (2005). Pax6, Tbr2, and Tbr1 are expressed sequentially by radial glia, intermediate progenitor cells, and postmitotic neurons in developing neocortex. J Neurosci 25:247–251.
sources.relevance: Pax6→Tbr2→Tbr1 转录因子接力级联的直接实验证明；鉴定 IPC 分子标志

sources.citation: McKenna WL, Betancourt J, Larkin KA, et al. (2011). Tbr1 and Fezf2 regulate alternate corticofugal neuronal identities during neocortical development. J Neurosci 31:549–564.
sources.relevance: TBR1 直接抑制 Fezf2 决定 L6 vs L5 层命运；FEZF2/TBR1 互斥开关机制

sources.citation: Noctor SC, Martínez-Cerdeño V, Ivic L, Kriegstein AR (2004). Cortical neurons arise in symmetric and asymmetric division zones and migrate through specific phases. Nat Neurosci 7:136–144.
sources.relevance: 通过延时活体成像直接追踪皮层神经元的迁移分期（不对称分裂→横向迁移→放射迁移）

sources.citation: Fietz SA, Kelava I, Vogt J, et al. (2010). OSVZ progenitors of human and ferret neocortex are epithelial-like and expand by integrin signaling. Nat Neurosci 13:690–699.
sources.relevance: 发现人类和雪貂 OSVZ 中存在大量上皮样 oRGC；提供灵长类皮层扩张的细胞基础

sources.citation: Hansen DV, Lui JH, Parker PR, Kriegstein AR (2010). Neurogenic radial glia in the outer subventricular zone of human neocortex. Nature 464:554–561.
sources.relevance: 同年独立发现人类 OSVZ 外放射状胶质细胞；奠定 oRGC 作为皮层扩张关键机制的地位

sources.citation: Suzuki IK, Gacquer D, Van Heurck R, et al. (2018). Human-specific NOTCH2NL genes expand cortical neurogenesis through Delta/Notch regulation. Cell 173:1370–1384.
sources.relevance: NOTCH2NLB 延长皮层祖细胞自我更新，使克隆体积增大约 3 倍；DLL1-cis 竞争机制

sources.citation: Fiddes IT, Lodewijk GA, Mooring M, et al. (2018). Human-specific NOTCH2NL genes affect Notch signaling and cortical neurogenesis. Cell 173:1356–1369.
sources.relevance: 与 S7 同时发表；1q21.1 CNV 与小头畸形/大头畸形的因果联系；NOTCH2NL 进化起源

sources.citation: Cardenas A & Bhatt DL (2022). Coordinating cerebral cortical construction and connectivity: unifying influence of radial progenitors. Neuron 110:601–616.
sources.relevance: 综合综述：aRGC 双重功能（干细胞 + 迁移支架）、克隆组织与皮层柱、oRGC 的 MST

sources.citation: Malatesta P, Gruber VF, Bhatt DL (2022). Progenitor-based cell biological aspects of neocortex development and evolution. Front Cell Dev Biol 10:885918.
sources.relevance: aRGC vs oRGC 系统对比；OSVZ 在 gyrencephalic 物种中的比较；细胞极性与纺锤方向
